# Shoonya Zomerstage 2027

> Zomerstage is Shoonya Dance Centre's annual dance and yoga retreat in the South of France. The 2027 edition runs 3–9 July 2027: six nights and five full class days at a resort near Mont Ventoux, reserved for participants. Registration is not open yet.

## Key facts
- Dates: 3–9 July 2027 — arrive Saturday 3 July, leave Friday 9 July; six nights, five full class days.
- Location: a peaceful village in the South of France, near Mont Ventoux and Provençal towns such as Lourmarin and Bonnieux. The entire resort is reserved for participants.
- Format: dance and yoga classes in the mornings and late evenings; free afternoons; 95+ hours of classes offered across the week. A theme night and parties every evening.
- Included: six-night stay, three organic and locally sourced meals a day plus an afternoon snack, and all the dance and yoga classes you choose.
- Meals: all meals are vegetarian, with the option to eat non-vegetarian at dinner (chosen at registration; non-vegetarian diners are seated at their own table at dinner).
- Not included: transport to the resort, drinks.
- Level: speed courses for first-time dancers and advanced courses for dancers with more experience.
- Organiser: Shoonya Dance Centre, a non-profit dance & culture organisation based in Ghent, Belgium.

## Prices (per person)

Prices include six nights, all meals and every class a participant chooses. Transport and drinks are separate.
- Sleeping loft (max. 18 people): €670
- 4-person room: €895
- 3-person room: €950
- 2-person room: €980
- Single room: €1,095

## Registration & payment
- Requests are open: https://tickets.shoonyadance.com/register/zomerstage?edition=zomerstage-2027&lang=en. Send your own request with your Shoonya ID. For a room, we check your request and room group before approval; each roommate needs a valid Shoonya ID and their own form. Sleeping-loft requests are approved automatically while places remain (18 places). There is one single room, and it needs no roommate details. When it is taken, you can join its waiting list. Once approved, your place is held for 8 days to pay the €200 non-refundable deposit.
- A €200 deposit per person confirms a spot and is non-refundable.
- A second instalment of €250 is due by 15 January 2027 and the remaining balance by 1 May 2027, both by bank transfer.
- Cancellation (per participant): before 1 January 2027 → you lose the €200 deposit; before 1 March 2027 → €500; after 1 March 2027 → full amount.
